note: A sandbox's reason as a code (observed_reason_code, beside the sentence observed_reason), as the computers service writes it on a computer the fleet runs (the Caveman computers service, the vocabulary's one home). scripts/generate-cloud-sdk.mjs writes each code and its wait into each SDK; the Caveman sandbox test harness TestSandboxReasonsParity holds this file to the Go vocabulary and to the contract's description of the field, so a code added there and not here fails a test. wait: what a client's wait for a state does on the code, the sandbox not yet in that state: continues (it passes by itself: the wait goes on, even while the sandbox reads failed), ends (it needs the caller or the operator: the wait ends), ends_if_failed (as a sandbox with no code: the wait ends once it has failed). A code a client does not know is read as none. sentence: what the sandbox's observed_reason says with the code; <ref> is a reference the operator finds the cause by, and <time> when the copy of its disk the sandbox came back from was made (RFC 3339, UTC).

waiting_for_capacity.sentence: Waiting for room: Cloud is short of capacity for this computer right now and keeps trying.

host_unavailable.sentence: Its host is restarting or not answering just now; Cloud tries again in a moment.

stopped_by_host.sentence: Its host restarted or ran short of memory, so it was stopped; its disk is kept. Start it again.

host_maintenance.sentence: Its host is in maintenance; it starts again once that is done.

busy.sentence: An earlier operation on it is still under way; Cloud tries again shortly.

waiting_for_funding.sentence: Waiting for funding: this organization's compute funds or limits do not let it run now.

funding_check_unavailable.sentence: the installation's funding check did not answer

organization_paused.sentence: Cloud computers are paused for this organization. Contact support to have them turned back on.

ended.sentence: It stopped running: it shut down, rebooted or crashed. Start it again to use it.

out_of_memory.sentence: It ran out of memory and was stopped; a larger size has more.

disk_lost.sentence: Its disk was lost and it cannot be started again; delete it.

settings_refused.sentence: This Cloud cannot run it as asked; change its settings or ask the operator.

snapshot_gone.sentence: The snapshot it was to be made from is gone, so it cannot be made; delete it, and make one from another snapshot.

internal_error.sentence: Cloud could not do this just now (reference <ref>); it is tried again, and the operator can find why with that reference.

recovered_from_copy.sentence: It came back on another host from a copy of its disk made at <time>; what it did after that was lost.

held_after_recovery.sentence: It came back on another host from an old copy of its disk, losing what it did after that copy, and stays stopped until it is stopped and started again.

pausing.sentence: pausing in place, its guest giving memory back

paused_under_pressure.sentence: paused by its host under pressure on its CPU or memory: it runs again once the pressure ends

slowed_under_pressure.sentence: slowed by its host under CPU pressure
